stale 'the only path that writes stderr' parenthetical in _scan_dependencies docstring (two stderr paths since #1197)
skipped source-order under-tested; mixed path did not assert every-dropped summary absent
prefer NamedTuple over positional 2-tuple of two list[str] to name found/skipped slots

fix_decisions.evidence: below the 'important' fix threshold; issue ACs specify a plain 2-tuple with list[str] wrappers, single internal consumer; plain tuple is a legitimate pragmatic choice
